description: This file contains utility functions for tensor operations, axis normalization, type casting, and conversions related to PyTorch tensors, with some references to numpy-like behavior.

classes.name: AxisError
classes.description: Custom error class for axis out-of-bounds errors.

classes.name: UFuncTypeError
classes.description: Custom error class for type errors related to ufunc operations.

methods.name: is_sequence
methods.description: Checks if a sequence is a non-string iterable.

methods.name: cast_if_needed
methods.description: Casts a tensor to a specified dtype if needed.

methods.name: cast_int_to_float
methods.description: Converts integer or boolean tensors to float dtype.

methods.name: normalize_axis_index
methods.description: Normalizes a single axis index, handling negative indices.

methods.name: normalize_axis_tuple
methods.description: Normalizes axis argument into a tuple of non-negative axes.

methods.name: allow_only_single_axis
methods.description: Ensures axis argument contains only a single axis.

methods.name: expand_shape
methods.description: Expands a shape to include new axes at specified positions.

methods.name: apply_keepdims
methods.description: Reshapes tensor to keep dimensions after reduction.

methods.name: axis_none_flatten
methods.description: Flattens tensors if axis is None.

methods.name: typecast_tensor
methods.description: Typecasts a tensor to a target dtype with casting rules.

methods.name: typecast_tensors
methods.description: Typecasts multiple tensors to a target dtype.

methods.name: _try_convert_to_tensor
methods.description: Attempts to convert an object to a torch tensor.

methods.name: _coerce_to_tensor
methods.description: Core function to coerce an object into a tensor with specified dtype and shape.

methods.name: ndarrays_to_tensors
methods.description: Converts ndarray objects within inputs to tensors.
